answer: Staked identity slots resist sybils: each agent must lock 20 POA for 60 epochs to hold one slot, and a funder's nth slot costs 20 times 1.3 to the power n minus 1, so ten fakes need about 640 POA. A lantern audit samples 8 percent of slots each epoch and checks funding graphs on-chain; an anchor deposit is slashed 50 percent on a match, and no ocean of cheap wallets can pass.
